messages:
Amelia (Product): starting a short thread to pin down a tiered canary + pin exception playbook. customer pain: surprise migrations and unclear pin durations. goal: reduce surprise, make pins auditable, and define rollout gates.

Sanjay (Eng-ML): ok. propose two canary lanes: pilot (1% opt-in tenants, manual invite) and broad (up to 5% stable sampling). evaluate with offline holdout + live diffs.

Maya (Platform): infra notes: prefix-hash sampling, stable salt, billing-exempt marker for shadow requests, and KV pre-warm for pilot cohorts. add admin toggle per model.

Ruben (Eng-Platform): API design idea: POST /models/:id/canary {cohort,duration_days,billing_mode} and pin metadata fields: pin_owner, pin_ttl_end, pin_tier, manual_hold, history (newline-delimited).

Ian (Customer-Success): customers want explicit pin durations (30/90/180/forever) and a migration-runway SLA: 60 days notice when we deprecate a pinned model unless customer bought extension. include exportable dates in reports.

Amelia (Product): canary pass criteria suggestion (preliminary): offline parity >=97% relative to incumbent; safety delta <=0.3%; p95 latency <= +10%. fail -> do not promote.

Sanjay (Eng-ML): regression report must include exact prompts that regressed, incumbent vs candidate outputs, seeds, and metric numbers. store eval-harness version with model binary for audit.

Maya (Platform): ops-bot: create runbook templates for canary-fail and canary-promote. also emit telemetry events: canary_request/canary_response/canary_eval_score.

ops-bot: /runbook new canary-failure --template quick-fail --attach sample-diff-report

ops-bot: /runbook new canary-promote --template promote-with-rollback --notify sales,cs,security

Amelia (Product): pricing implications: pilot canaries free; broad includes 1% free sampling; additional canary traffic credited or billback depending on Dedicated contract. enterprise pin extensions = paid add-on. need ops-cost estimate.

Ruben (Eng-Platform): infra TODOs: add canary_mode flag in routing, implement billing-exempt header, admin toggle in console, and telemetry schema. est 3 engineer-weeks.

Sanjay (Eng-ML): recommend quarterly rollback drills to exercise the path (dry-run).

Ian (Customer-Success): comms plan: 10-day pre-notice for tenants with pinned models, console banner during canary, and downloadable regression report at end. include a customer evidence pack for Sales.

Amelia (Product): action items:
- Sanjay: prototype eval-parity check (due 2024-08-09)
- Ruben: routing + telemetry schema PR (due 2024-09-02)
- Maya: ops-bot templates + sampling impl (due 2024-08-16)
- Ian: comms + report copy (due 2024-08-12)
- Amelia: pricing note + policy draft (due 2024-08-23)
React with :white_check_mark: to accept or :thinking_face: to renegotiate.

Ruben (Eng-Platform): :white_check_mark:

Sanjay (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark:

Maya (Platform): :white_check_mark: one caveat: enterprise tenants default to 1-2% for broad to limit cost.

Ian (Customer-Success): :white_check_mark: will validate pilot wording with customers tomorrow.

Amelia (Product): thanks all — I'll post spec link here when ready and schedule a pilot demo next week.
